theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dtsd_sh_dyadic_good_radii
theorems.statement: (∀ (P : ℕ) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (B : ℝ≥0∞), IsFiniteMeasure μ → IsFiniteMeasure μ' → Measurable f → 0 < ρ → μ {x | f x < ρ} ≤ B → ∃ r ∈ Ioo (ρ / 2) ρ, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ {x | r - h < f x ∧ f x < r}) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (4 / ρ) * B ∧ liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ' {x | r - h < f x ∧ f x < r}) (𝓝[>] 0) < ∞) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (d : Euclid P → ℝ) (C : NNReal) (M M' : ℝ≥0∞), IsFiniteMeasure μ → IsFiniteMeasure μ' → Measurable d → M ≠ ∞ → M' ≠ ∞ → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 1 / 4 → μ {x | d x < r} ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (m + 2)) * M ∧ μ' {x | d x < r} ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (m + 2)) * M') → ∃ r : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 3) < r j ∧ r j < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 2)) ∧ StrictAnti r ∧ (∀ j, μ {x | d x < r j} ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((j + 2) * (m + 2))) * M ∧ μ' {x | d x < r j} ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((j + 2) * (m + 2))) * M') ∧ Tendsto (fun j => μ {x | d x < r j}) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ Tendsto (fun j => μ' {x | d x < r j}) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ (∀ j, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ {x | r j - h < d x ∧ d x < r j}) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ 4 * C * ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((j + 2) * (m + 1))) * M) ∧ (∀ j, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ' {x | r j - h < d x ∧ d x < r j}) (𝓝[>] 0) < ∞)
